name: Arduino Uno R3
shortDescription: Classic 8-bit AVR board for learning and prototyping.
description: The Arduino Uno R3 is a microcontroller board based on the ATmega328P. Perfect for beginners and hobbyists. Includes USB-B connector, 14 digital I/O pins, and 6 analog inputs.

name: ESP32 DevKit V1
shortDescription: Wi-Fi + Bluetooth MCU with dual-core processing.
description: ESP32 DevKit V1 features the ESP-WROOM-32 module with Wi-Fi and Bluetooth connectivity. Ideal for IoT projects requiring low power and high performance.

name: STM32F103C8T6 Blue Pill
shortDescription: ARM Cortex-M3 development board for advanced makers.
description: The STM32F103C8T6 'Blue Pill' offers 72MHz Cortex-M3 performance with 64KB Flash and 20KB RAM. Great for embedded experimentation.

name: HC-SR04 Ultrasonic Sensor
shortDescription: Affordable distance sensor for robotics and DIY.
description: The HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor provides 2cm-400cm non-contact measurement with a ranging accuracy up to 3mm.

name: BME280 Temperature Humidity Pressure Sensor
description: The BME280 measures temperature, humidity, and barometric pressure with high accuracy. Supports I2C and SPI interfaces.
